Hi Demo Author,

Thank you for reaching out and for partnering with BookLeaf. I understand it can be confusing not knowing which quarter your pending royalty of ₹1,500 belongs to, and I’m sorry for any uncertainty this may have caused.

Royalties are calculated on a quarterly basis (Jan‑Mar, Apr‑Jun, Jul‑Sep, Oct‑Dec). Once a quarter closes, we compute the net profit (MRP minus printing cost, platform commission and shipping), apply the 80/20 split, and then process payments within 45 days of the quarter’s end. A balance is only paid out once it reaches the minimum threshold of INR 1,000; smaller amounts roll forward to the next payout cycle.

At this stage we need to confirm the exact accrual quarter for your pending amount and verify that your bank details are up‑to‑date. Our next step is to review the payout records and follow up with you within 48 hours with a clear update.

If you have any additional information (e.g., recent bank verification details) you’d like to share here, please do so and we’ll pass it along to the team.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
BookLeaf Support Team

Hi Demo Author,

Thank you for reaching out. I understand you’d like to update the description of your published book and are wondering about the timeline.

You can submit the revised description here in this chat or via your BookLeaf dashboard. Once we receive the new text, our production team will process the change. Typically, updated metadata appears on retailer sites within 3–5 business days.

Next steps:
1. Please share the exact wording you’d like to use for the description.
2. Our team will forward it to the production team and confirm the update.
3. We will follow up with you within 48 hours to let you know the status.

We appreciate your partnership and are here to help.

Warm regards,
BookLeaf Support Team
